person.name: Enrik Rushiti
person.headline: Apps, automation & games.
person.intro: I build things I want to use. Sometimes that means a better everyday tool. Sometimes it means a mobile app, a research system, or a game with friends.
person.about: I’m a Computer Science graduate from Mount Royal University. My background spans data analysis at Suncor, hands-on IT work, and building software around problems I keep running into.
person.outside: Outside the code: natural bodybuilding, bioenergetics, and philosophy. A lot of my projects start with those interests.

education.detail: GIS cognate · President’s & Dean’s Honor Roll

experience.summary: Hardware diagnostics, refurbishment, system imaging, and device lifecycle management.
Data validation and schema work, cross-functional coordination, and translating technical findings for stakeholders.

projects.name: EnrikDraw
projects.summary: Adds cloud document storage and autosave to Excalidraw drawings that remain editable inside Notion embeds.
projects.role: Repository owner; wrapper and persistence layer over Excalidraw.
bullets: Built an Excalidraw wrapper with persistent drawing URLs, Supabase storage, autosave, and editable Notion embeds.
Implemented a protected management page and token-checked drawing access; kept drawing data portable in Excalidraw’s native format.
projects.state: Repository lists a Vercel homepage. Current uptime was not tested; the drawing editor itself is Excalidraw.

feature.hook: A whiteboard that stays where you put it.
feature.outcome: Cloud persistence for Excalidraw, right inside Notion.

projects.name: Insertion Physique Studio
projects.summary: Interactive 3D physique studio for exploring muscle insertions, skeletal proportions, development, poses, and body measurements.
projects.role: Repository owner; application built around credited external anatomy assets.
bullets: Built a 3D physique studio with 24 adjustable traits, 12 poses, side-by-side comparisons, shareable configurations, and PNG export.
Integrated anatomical asset processing, surface-based measurements, and rendering that reduces GPU work when the scene is idle.
projects.state: Functional application documented in the repository. Anatomical sculpt and atlas come from credited third parties; model outputs are illustrative.

feature.hook: Make one change. See the whole physique respond.
feature.outcome: A 3D studio for physique traits, poses, and comparisons.

projects.name: MediaDownloader
projects.summary: Desktop media downloader with MP3/MP4 conversion, a managed queue, progress display, settings, and download history.
projects.role: Repository owner; desktop application implementation.
bullets: Built a desktop MP3/MP4 downloader with queue controls, progress reporting, configurable conversion, and SQLite download history.
Integrated yt-dlp and FFmpeg, background processing, collision-safe output handling, and Windows executable packaging.
projects.state: Repository name is historical; current README calls the app MediaDownloader and documents several supported providers.

feature.hook: A proper queue for media downloads.
feature.outcome: A desktop tool for batch downloads and MP3/MP4 conversion.

projects.name: Streak Buddy
projects.summary: Habit accountability app with photo proof, buddy review, time-zone-aware streaks, reminders, and live leaderboards.
projects.role: Repository owner; mobile app implementation.
bullets: Built a habit accountability app with photo proof uploads, buddy invitations, story-style reviews, and real-time leaderboards.
Implemented Firebase authentication/storage, time-zone-aware streak calculation, push reminders, and scheduled Cloud Functions.
projects.state: Buddy votes provide social feedback; streaks are based on submission timing, not approval. Current distribution status is unverified.

feature.hook: Habits with something to show for them.
feature.outcome: Photo proof, friend reviews, and daily streaks.

projects.name: Article to PDF
projects.summary: Converts Substack posts, X posts, and X articles into offline PDFs with links, images, structured formatting, and bookmarks.
projects.role: Repository owner; extraction and PDF application.
bullets: Built a Next.js converter that normalizes Substack and X content into structured blocks and generates bookmarked PDFs.
Handled Unicode fonts, nested content, clickable links, and pagination of long infographics.
projects.state: Functional local application documented with Windows launcher and deployment options. No current hosted URL confirmed.

feature.hook: Keep the article. Take it offline.
feature.outcome: Substack and X articles turned into readable PDFs.

projects.name: Ethan Portfolio Website
projects.summary: Portfolio website for Ethan Alfandary showcasing audience growth, media systems, and creative work.
projects.role: Repository owner; website for Ethan.
bullets: Built an Astro and Tailwind portfolio with reusable components, centralized content data, and versioned visual redesigns.
projects.state: README documents version 2.2 and historical release tags. Hosting and client results were not independently verified.

feature.hook: A home for someone else's body of work.
feature.outcome: A portfolio for media, audience growth, and creative direction.

projects.name: Art Gallery REST API
projects.summary: REST API for paintings, artists, and galleries, including filters by country, artist, gallery, year, title, and color.
projects.role: Repository owner; coursework implementation.
bullets: Implemented Express endpoints over JSON art datasets, with query filters and explicit responses for missing records.
projects.state: 2022 coursework. README contains historical Glitch URLs; current availability is unverified.

projects.name: Daily Planner Across Programming Paradigms
projects.summary: Team daily-planner assignment solving activity scheduling in imperative and declarative programming styles.
projects.role: Team member with Nimrat Brar and Pelvain Dhanda, explicitly credited in README.
bullets: Collaborated on a daily activity scheduler implemented across Java, Prolog, and Haskell to compare imperative and declarative approaches.
projects.state: 2023 coursework. Group membership is verified; the exact individual division of implementation is not recorded.

projects.name: Don't Touch That
projects.summary: Team Roblox chaos game prototype where forbidden objects reward the player and trigger hazards for everyone.
projects.role: Team project with Ethan and Ninety; repository owner.
bullets: Collaborated on a Roblox prototype that links forbidden-object interactions to shared chaos, timed hazards, rewards, and extraction.
projects.state: Main holds the starter; gameplay is on prototype/forbidden-room. Not published to Roblox. Branch config confirms five object types and timed hazard parameters.

projects.name: Furry Land Customer App
projects.summary: Mobile dog-grooming prototype with pet profiles, a seven-step booking flow, appointment management, and payment UI.
projects.role: Repository owner; customer app prototype.
bullets: Built a React Native booking prototype with pet profiles, a seven-step booking flow, appointment tracking, and configurable cancellation rules.
Separated booking and payment services behind adapters for later integration; current authentication, booking data, and payment processing are mocked.
projects.state: UI prototype, not a deployed booking/payment system. Push notifications and calendar export include stubs.

projects.name: GrimeWire Music Explorer
projects.summary: Song browser with title, artist, and genre filters, playlist controls, and song-detail visualizations.
projects.role: Team coursework with Shayne Prakash; both credited in UI.
bullets: Co-developed a JavaScript music explorer with searchable song data, playlist controls, and Chart.js visualizations.
projects.state: 2022 team coursework. Individual division of work has not been confirmed.

projects.name: Instagram Reels Metadata Scraper
projects.summary: Extracts accessible Reel metadata through a CLI, browser dashboard, and Windows launcher, with caching and optional thumbnail OCR.
projects.role: Repository owner; tool implementation.
bullets: Built a shared scraping core with CLI and Flask interfaces, SQLite caching, retries, rate handling, and CSV/TSV export.
Added optional thumbnail OCR and Windows executable packaging with a first-run setup wizard.
projects.state: Executable packaging and setup are documented. Current Instagram compatibility was not exercised.

projects.name: Loot Goblins
projects.summary: Team Roblox raid prototype centered on stealing loot, world reactions, contested carrying, escape, and banking rewards.
projects.role: Team project with Ethan and Ninety; repository owner.
bullets: Collaborated on a Roblox raid prototype with contested loot, reactive hazards, carrying and escape mechanics, timed rounds, and banking rewards.
Established a shared source workflow with pinned tools, automated checks, pull requests, and a one-click Studio launcher.
projects.state: README describes a playable vertical slice. Human playtesting remains the measure of whether the loop works.

projects.name: n8n and Oracle Automation Infrastructure
projects.summary: Oracle VM provisioning and HTTPS self-hosted n8n infrastructure, with workflow and WorkJam session support.
projects.role: Repository owner; infrastructure and automation setup.
bullets: Built an Oracle Cloud capacity-provisioning tool and deployed self-hosted n8n behind HTTPS using Docker Compose and Caddy.
Organized operational guides and automation support scripts in version control.
projects.state: Infrastructure is documented as deployed. The repository contains workflow guidance rather than evidence of a complete exported workflow suite.

projects.name: Picard Performance Platform
projects.summary: Coaching platform foundation with a coach web dashboard, role-aware mobile app, shared packages, and database security.
projects.role: Repository owner; platform implementation for Ben Picard.
bullets: Built the Phase 1 authentication and access-control foundation for a coaching platform across a Next.js dashboard and Expo mobile app.
Added coach/client routing, secure mobile session storage, shared validation/types, Supabase migrations, and automated security checks.
projects.state: Phase 1 only. Product tabs largely remain placeholders; hosted development setup and validation are still required per repository documentation.

projects.name: Roblox Game Development Template
projects.summary: Reusable team scaffolding for Roblox projects with pinned tools, CI, onboarding docs, and one-click launchers.
projects.role: Repository owner; team workflow with Ethan and Ninety.
bullets: Packaged reusable Roblox scaffolding with pinned tooling, format/lint/build checks, CI, team onboarding, and one-click launchers.
Added PowerShell project-generation and smoke-check scripts to make new games start from a consistent source workflow.
projects.state: Developer tooling used by the team’s game repositories. This is a reusable template, not a released game.

projects.name: StreakPet
projects.summary: Whop community streak app with an evolving pet dragon, daily check-ins, leaderboards, reminders, and member growth entitlements.
projects.role: Repository owner; Whop app implementation.
bullets: Built a Whop-integrated streak app with evolving pet stages, member-local daily check-ins, leaderboards, and community configuration.
Implemented reminder scheduling, growth entitlements, subscription hooks, and payment-ledger code; launch integration tasks remain.
projects.state: Repository launch checklist still shows payment-ledger migration, webhook setup, deployment verification, and marketplace review work. Revenue is not verified.

projects.name: SYFER 15 Minute BTC Research
projects.summary: 15-minute BTC prediction-market research system with data capture, paper execution, settlement analysis, and strategy diagnostics.
projects.role: Repository owner; research and trading infrastructure.
bullets: Adapted BTC market infrastructure to 15-minute contracts with paper execution, risk controls, settlement-reference audits, and chronological strategy evaluation.
projects.state: Latest README identifies paper-only research. Historical live trials did not establish profitability; live mode is disabled in that documented state.

projects.name: SYFER BTC Dashboard and Research
projects.summary: BTC prediction-market infrastructure with streaming data, strategy evaluation, execution/risk tooling, dashboard, and settlement research.
projects.role: Repository owner; research and trading infrastructure.
bullets: Built continuously running BTC market infrastructure with WebSocket feeds, signal evaluation, persistent risk controls, a FastAPI dashboard, and Discord reporting.
Developed paper evaluation and settlement-aware bidding research with execution reconciliation and operational health checks.
projects.state: Earlier résumé reports live deployment; latest repository documentation describes paper mode and a new PCB research focus. No profitable live record is claimed.

projects.name: SYFER Weather Market Research
projects.summary: Temperature-market research platform with multi-venue adapters, data collection, paper broker, execution diagnostics, and dashboard.
projects.role: Repository owner; research platform implementation.
bullets: Built a weather-market research platform with standardized venue adapters, forecast/observation capture, and a persistent paper broker.
Added decision-to-settlement tracking, execution diagnostics, and dashboard reporting; documented the move to 24 Kalshi city series on Oracle Cloud.
projects.state: Latest README describes Kalshi data collection and paper operation with live trading disabled. A positive forward trading result is not established.

projects.name: Travel Destination Website
projects.summary: Multi-page travel website with destination cards, navigation, images, and shared styling.
projects.role: Individual coursework; Enrik credited in source.
bullets: Created a multi-page travel website with linked destination pages and consistent HTML/CSS styling.
projects.state: 2022 coursework. Repository contains source pages and assignment instructions.

projects.name: Weather Signal Discord Bot
projects.summary: Early weather prediction-market signal bot with forecast ingestion, scheduled Discord cards, outcome resolution, and session reporting.
projects.role: Repository owner; early weather research tool.
bullets: Implemented scheduled weather signal cards by combining NOAA and Open-Meteo forecast inputs with prediction-market data and outcome reporting.
projects.state: Earlier, separate repository from Syfer-Weather-Bot. No proven profitability or current deployment is inferred.

projects.name: Web of Shadows DS Modding Tools
projects.summary: Private game-modding research with extraction/rebuild tools, round-trip checks, versioned patches, and emulator playtest workflows.
projects.role: Repository owner; tooling and reverse-engineering research.
bullets: Developed Python tooling to extract, rebuild, and verify Nintendo DS game archives while preserving original data.
Added versioned patch workflows, assembly-based experiments, and emulator checkpoint/playtest tooling.
projects.state: Private research. Game ROMs, extracted commercial assets, and saves are excluded from portfolio deliverables.

projects.name: WorkJam to Google Calendar
projects.summary: Syncs WorkJam shifts to a dedicated Google Calendar, updating changed events and removing cancelled shifts it manages.
projects.role: Repository owner; calendar integration tool.
bullets: Built an idempotent WorkJam-to-Google Calendar sync with OAuth, session renewal, changed/cancelled shift reconciliation, and dry-run mode.
Added container scheduling, encrypted state support, and failure notifications while preserving unrelated calendar events.
projects.state: Repository documents deployment paths and 30 offline reconciliation tests. Current live scheduling was not tested.

projects.name: X Bookmarks Discord Digest
projects.summary: Turns X bookmarks into categorized Discord digests and actionable follow-ups, with caching, scheduling, and per-user authentication.
projects.role: Repository owner; Discord bot implementation.
bullets: Built a Discord bot that retrieves X bookmarks, enriches linked content, and generates categorized AI digests and action prompts.
Added cached analysis, scheduled digests, token usage tracking, and encrypted per-user authentication storage.
projects.state: Discord bot is separate from bundled reference skill material. Current deployment and external API compatibility are unverified.

projects.name: YouTube Metadata Extractor
projects.summary: Web tool extracting video metadata, thumbnails with OCR, timestamped transcripts, and spreadsheet-ready output.
projects.role: Repository owner; metadata extraction application.
bullets: Built an Express web tool that combines video metadata, thumbnail OCR, and timestamped transcripts into Markdown and spreadsheet-ready exports.
projects.state: Used as a video research utility. Current API compatibility and hosting were not exercised.
